data.name: Tomato and egg stir-fry

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Beat the eggs, cut the tomatoes into small chunks and mince the garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat. Scramble the eggs until set, then transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the remaining oil and garlic. Stir briefly, then add tomatoes and cook for 1–2 minutes until softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Return the eggs, add salt and sugar, and fold together until hot.
